name: Sheet Pan Chicken Quesadilla
desc: Creamy shredded chicken and cheddar folded inside overlapping tortillas, pressed under a second sheet pan and baked crisp.

source.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Quesadilla
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 3 cups shredded cooked chicken (from 1 rotisserie chicken)
1 cup salsa (or 1 (1 oz) packet taco seasoning)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Spray an 18x13 in sheet pan with cooking spray.
Mix the chicken, cream cheese and salsa or seasoning until evenly combined.
Lay 6 tortillas around the edges of the pan, overlapping, with half of each hanging over the rim. Put 1 tortilla in the center gap.
Sprinkle half the cheddar over the tortillas, spread the chicken mixture on top, and cover with the rest of the cheddar.
Lay the last tortilla in the center, then fold the overhanging tortillas in toward the middle.
Set a second sheet pan on top and press down. Bake 20 minutes with the pan on top.
Remove the top pan and bake 5 minutes more, until the top is golden and crisp and the filling is hot. Cool 5 minutes, then cut into squares.
tips: About 5 minutes of hands-on time with rotisserie chicken.
Serve with sour cream, salsa or guacamole.
